remarks: Charming and meticulously cared for, this 3-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom ranch-style home is situated in a prime location! The kitchen was completely renovated with brand new white shaker cabinets, granite countertops, and stainless steel appliances. The home boasts hardwood floors throughout, central air conditioning, and a finished bonus room in the basement. The basement also provides ample storage space and a full-sized laundry area. Enjoy relaxing on the spacious covered rear deck. Additional storage can be found in the garage. Located on a quiet street, this home is conveniently close to highways and shopping, making it perfect for commuters and those with busy lifestyles. Excellent credit, verifiable income, and references are a must. Schedule your private viewing before it's gone!
